chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: Next you will see how to perform various mathematical operations on ndarrays.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: Let's use a random array of integers.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: Let's create an array with shape five rows and four columns.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: Let's see the output.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: So here's an array with five rows, four columns, and

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: all the values between the range zero and ten.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: Note how we used seed the random number generator with a constant to get

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: the same sequence of numbers every time.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: Let's run again and see if the output remains the same.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: You can see that we have the same values for the array.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: Summing all the elements in an array is as simple as calling the function sum on the array.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: Here is our array a and we call the sum function on it.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: Let's check the output.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: This is our array and this is sum of all the elements present in the array,

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: which comes out to be 79.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: We can also sum in a specific direction of the array.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: What I mean by direction is along rows or columns.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: NumPy gives this direction a special name.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: It is called axis.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: Axis is equal to zero signifies rows and axis is equal to one indicates columns.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: Remember this terminology as you will use it frequently.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: Let's code to make things clear.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: Passing the parameter axis along with the specific value will give you the sum along

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: that axis.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: To understand this, let's first see the output.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: To get the sum of each column, we pass the value to the axis attribute as zero.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: And to get the sum of the rows, we pass the value as one.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: To understand this, imagine if you wanted to sum the values of each column,

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: what would you iterate on?

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: You would say something like for each column, sum all the values of each row of that column.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: So you would essentially iterate over the rows.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: Hence we pass axis equal to zero to compute column sums and similarly axis equal to one for

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: row sums.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: Observe the output when we pass axis equal to zero.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: We get four values.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: These are basically the sum of each columns.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: And when we pass axis equal to one, we get five values which are sum of each rows.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: Let's go ahead and try some basic operation like finding minimum, maximum and mean of an array.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: So if I want minimum along columns, I have to go through each row of each column.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: So axis equal to zero to get the minimum of each column.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: To get the maximum of each row, similarly we call a max function and pass axis equal to one.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: Just calling a dot mean that is array dot mean will give us the mean of the entire array.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: Of course we can get mean along each axis as we did for max and min.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: Observe the output.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: Minimum of the first column is one which is showed over here.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: This value is essentially minimum of the first column.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: This is of second, this is of third and this is of fourth.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: Similarly for maximum of the each row, you can observe that for the first row the maximum

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: is five and it is shown here.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: The mean of all the elements is 3.95 which is calculated using the mean function.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: There are many more functions which you can experiment with.

chunks.title: Operations on ndarrays
chunks.text: Check the documentation link in the instructor's notes.
